style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 1ft 6 Pre Lit Snowy Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Bring a touch of the winter woods inside with our Snowy Pre Lit Christmas Tree. </p><p>Standing at 45cm, this tree is crafted from faux fir foliage flocked with a snow effect, in which a series of warm white LEDs on a green cable are nestled, to give the branches a beautiful glow. </p><p>Arrange one of these trees either side of an interior door, or place this on a table in the living room and decorate it with silver and wooden ornaments for a beautifully rustic note to your decorations. </p><p>To illuminate, simply insert 3 AA batteries into the battery box and switch to ‘on.’ Select the 6 hour timer function for an automatic shine at the same time each evening. </p><p>You should expect 30 – 50 hours of illumination time from your batteries before they will need refreshing.</p><ul><li>(H) 45cm<br></li><li>Lead Cable: 20cm<br></li><li>20 LEDs<br></li><li>Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included)<br></li><li>Indoor Battery Decoration<br></li><li>Optional 6 hour timer Size : ONE</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Bring a touch of the winter woods inside with our Snowy Pre Lit Christmas Tree. Standing at 45cm, this tree is crafted from faux fir foliage flocked with a snow effect, in which a series of warm white LEDs on a green cable are nestled, to give the branches a beautiful glow. Arrange one of these trees either side of an interior door, or place this on a table in the living room and decorate it with silver and wooden ornaments for a beautifully rustic note to your decorations. To illuminate, simply insert 3 AA batteries into the battery box and switch to ‘on.’ Select the 6 hour timer function for an automatic shine at the same time each evening. You should expect 30 – 50 hours of illumination time from your batteries before they will need refreshing. (H) 45cm Lead Cable: 20cm 20 LEDs Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included) Indoor Battery Decoration Optional 6 hour timer Size : ONE.
